CERTIFICATION_SUBSET.assumption: FCC whole machines not required where the C1PC/module route applies, per the wording inside J33 itself

FULL.assumption: every numbered line item needs its own whole machines, FCC = intel_wlan x antenna x 4

bracket.reading: 15 is inside the bracket: consistent with a mix where some WLAN cards take the C1PC/module route (no whole machine) and others do not. The Appendix 8-10 sits BELOW the floor of a 2-antenna / 2-WLAN-card project, so the Appendix cannot be the same reference scenario as J33. Neither value is reproducible from J33 alone.

j33_evidence.antenna_wlan_are: BUSINESS_COMPOSITION_DESCRIPTION - the note explains why RF certification consumes machines (antenna source x WLAN card matrix). It is not an executable calculation variable in the workbook: no cell formula consumes it.
j33_evidence.double_count_risk_if_added: HIGH - the Main Table per-SKU rate for RF certification is already the whole-machine count for that SKU; adding the J33 line items on top would count the same machines twice
j33_evidence.raw_text:
this data for 2 antenna source +2 wlan source refrence:
1.SRRC *2(PRC 型号核准);如果网卡数量大于天线数量，整机需求基于WLAN卡型号数量；
2.CE *4 =antenna *wlan（欧盟）,如果网卡数量大于天线数量，需额外提供网卡单体送测；
3.FCC(intel WLAN 数量*天线数量)*4（如果是C1PC ,就不需要整机）,其他wlan source(Non-intel) combine with CE.;
4.印尼* 2  .
5.Mexico *1.
6.资安*2（欧盟网络安全）

review_items.why: these Factors have more than one spec but nothing says which wave each spec belongs to. They are counted as CURRENT_WAVE by default, so CURRENT_WAVE equals FULL PROJECT for now. The Agent will not infer a second wave (DEC-04) - confirm the wave or accept this reading.

the Appendix total - which DEC-10 adopts - does not equal the Main Table per-SKU quantity x SKU count. The engine uses the Appendix total, keeps the Main Table derivation as audit evidence and reports the difference instead of editing the source. The result stays a single value: this is a source-data question, not a competing model, and the two are never added.

the Main Table x SKU relationship holds for part of the Certification grid only, so ORI-02 is PARTIALLY_RESOLVED and the rule pack cannot be finalised. DEC-10 decides WHICH column is adopted; it does not explain why the two columns disagree, so the difference stays registered for the Owner.

J33 explains the RF Certification composition for one declared antenna x WLAN combination and cannot be reproduced from the workbook. It is kept as explanatory evidence, is never added to the adopted Certification value, and does not oblige the MVP to collect antenna / WLAN inputs today.
